answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the signal graph. Re-attestations are stored in horizon and relic lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 8 dollars and 7 days per identity, which turns a 798 account sybil into a 7 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
